title: Tidy the Input
goal: Trim the noise, swap the underscores, and mind what each method returns.
hints: Which end of the text does trim_end leave dirty?
replace returns an owned String - exactly what the signature wants.
explanation: `trim()` removes whitespace from both ends and returns a `&str` view; `replace` then produces the owned `String` the signature promises. `trim_end()` compiles but leaves the leading spaces - the test catches it. Starting with `to_string()` skips trimming entirely, and the empty second step leaves a `&str` where a `String` is due (E0308). Chains type-check step by step; read them the same way.
